decision_basis: Three previously successful 5px pairs are lost against the matched control and against PR35.
Common-matched reference-unlocatable outputs increase 65/75 to67/75 against the control; no reduction against PR35.
Matched-reference object identities equal PR35; no reference recovery beyond the selected model.
The10px success gain against PR35 is already present in the unchanged-label L4control.

common_endpoints.reference_row_numbering: one-based within the separately identified scoring reference
common_endpoints.interpretation: Only common-matched slots have identical detection opportunity. Full-reference counts include missing detections; reduced unlocatable-side output alone is not improvement. Unlocatable slots have no scored hidden-coordinate error.

limits: The current checkpoint is an operational comparator, not a third training arm.
Primary and original references are scored separately. References are not changed after observing results.
Filename ranges are descriptive groups, not independent scenes or captures.
Corner availability on reference-v0 sides is a disagreement diagnostic; no hidden-coordinate error is computed.
Repeated development images do not establish unseen-scene generalization.
Single observations in a fixed order are descriptive CPU timings, not deployment benchmarks.
